theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_ims_partial_sum_reps
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), IsOpen U → ∀ q : ℕ, ∃ R' : IMRep U n, (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R'.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R'.mult y : ℝ) • R'.orient y) x = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (R r).carrier.indicator (fun y => ((R r).mult y : ℝ) • (R r).orient y) x) ∧ R'.measure ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (R r).measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
